```{r, include=FALSE}
library(highcharter)
options(highcharter.google_fonts = FALSE)
knitr::read_chunk(here::here("dev", "examples-charts", "bus-occupancy.R"))
```

The [interactive gallery](../series-gallery.html) renders a small example for
each series type registered by the shared bundle. The examples use local
data, including an embedded sample tile for the map. Open a chart title to
read the Highcharts API for that series. The contour plot requires a browser
with WebGPU support.

| Family | Examples |
| --- | --- |
| Basic series | [area](../series-gallery.html#area), [areaspline](../series-gallery.html#areaspline), [bar](../series-gallery.html#bar), [column](../series-gallery.html#column), [dotplot](../series-gallery.html#dotplot), [line](../series-gallery.html#line), [pie](../series-gallery.html#pie), [polygon](../series-gallery.html#polygon), [scatter](../series-gallery.html#scatter), [spline](../series-gallery.html#spline), [streamgraph](../series-gallery.html#streamgraph) |

| Stock | [candlestick](../series-gallery.html#candlestick), [flags](../series-gallery.html#flags), [heikinashi](../series-gallery.html#heikinashi), [hlc](../series-gallery.html#hlc), [hollowcandlestick](../series-gallery.html#hollowcandlestick), [ohlc](../series-gallery.html#ohlc), [pointandfigure](../series-gallery.html#pointandfigure), [renko](../series-gallery.html#renko) |
| Networks and hierarchies | [arcdiagram](../series-gallery.html#arcdiagram), [dependencywheel](../series-gallery.html#dependencywheel), [networkgraph](../series-gallery.html#networkgraph), [organization](../series-gallery.html#organization), [sankey](../series-gallery.html#sankey), [sunburst](../series-gallery.html#sunburst), [treegraph](../series-gallery.html#treegraph), [treemap](../series-gallery.html#treemap), [venn](../series-gallery.html#venn) |

The [R examples](https://github.com/jbkunst/highcharter/blob/HEAD/dev/R/test-highcharts-bundle.R) construct the widgets with `hchart()` or `hc_add_series()`.

## Seats and occupancy

Seven of the ten bus seats are occupied. An `item` series draws one symbol
per seat, so you can count both groups. A stacked `pictorial` series fills
the bus silhouette up to the same proportion.

```{r bus-capacity}
```

```{r count-seats}
```

```{r fill-bus}
```

To put a different image on each scatter series, see [Markers and tooltips](highcharts-api.html#markers-and-tooltips).

## Polar coordinates

The same monthly measurements can be drawn as a polar line or as columns.
For a polar range, supply the low and high value of each month.

```{r polar-charts}
polar_chart <- highchart() |>
  hc_chart(polar = TRUE) |>
  hc_xAxis(categories = as.character(citytemp$month), tickmarkPlacement = "on") |>
  hc_yAxis(title = list(text = "Temperature (°C)"))

polar_chart |> hc_add_series(type = "line", name = "Tokyo", data = citytemp$tokyo)
polar_chart |> hc_add_series(type = "column", name = "London", data = citytemp$london)

temperatures <- with(citytemp, Map(list, pmin(tokyo, london), pmax(tokyo, london)))
polar_chart |> hc_add_series(type = "columnrange", name = "Tokyo–London range",
                             data = temperatures)
```

## Worked examples in R

These recipes illustrate layouts, point fields and options for individual
series. Each example renders below its R code.

```{r series-recipes, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
library(dplyr)
recipes <- c("arcdiagram", "errorbar", "item", "packedbubble", "solidgauge",
             "tilemap", "vector", "venn", "wordcloud", "xrange")
for (name in recipes) {
  path <- here::here("dev", "examples-charts", paste0(name, ".R"))
  cat(knitr::spin_child(path), sep = "\n")
}
```
